better_answer_example: As a recent IT graduate with a strong interest in data analysis, I developed an e-commerce ordering application that involved designing the order flow and checkout validation process. Although it was a small project, I learned valuable lessons about teamwork and data analysis. One of the challenges we faced was card calculation errors, which we resolved through persistent troubleshooting. This experience not only deepened my understanding of data analysis but also taught me the importance of attention to detail and collaboration. I'm excited about this role because it aligns with my skills in Python, SQL, and Power BI, and I believe I can make a meaningful contribution to the team.
